video: Add functions to Mute/Unmute not to make a sound during testing Videos in some tests has an audio. It doesn't matter whether DUT sounds or not. It is convenient for developers that test automatically makes DUT mute during the test. Note that it matters that chrome processes for sound, because not only we want to measure metrics in chrome standard video playback but also chrome video playback behavior is changed by the existence of sound in the video. BUG=chromium:890733, chromium:911095 TEST=tast run video.Play* Change-Id: Ibe4895c1cfc6991beaf5672724bb8c9bf15f194c Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1390677 Commit-Ready: Hirokazu Honda <hiroh@chromium.org> Tested-by: Hirokazu Honda <hiroh@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Shuhei Takahashi <nya@chromium.org>

runtime_probe: load arbitrary probe config iff cros_debug=1 Because the probe config could be powerful, arbitrary probe config is only allowed when device is opt-out on purposely from ChromeOS security model. Caller of runtime_probe is only allowed to specify probe config when cros_debug == 1. For production, probe config is reviewed and checked-in under rootfs. The "subset of category to probe" is the only input from outside when cros_debug != 1. CQ-DEPEND=CL:1385973 BUG=chromium:908006,b:119155505,b:121297226 TEST=(1) Install a dev-key signed firmware. (2) Install test image and remove cros_debug from kernel cmdline. (3) emerge-nami runtime_probe & cros deploy (4) Flip the developer switch and see different return codes w/wo specify --config_file_path argument. Change-Id: I20862dfe9ebbe36e18dda9e73139b5660b3aa1ae Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1385907 Commit-Ready: Chun-ta Lin <itspeter@chromium.org> Tested-by: Chun-ta Lin <itspeter@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mattias Nissler <mnissler@chromium.org>
